title: Pay luxury car tax on taxable supplies of luxury cars
what: A dealer or importer making a taxable supply or importation of a luxury car pays luxury car tax.

laws.title: A New Tax System (Luxury Car Tax) Act 1999

sources.title: A New Tax System (Luxury Car Tax) Act 1999
sources.quote: You must pay the luxury car tax payable on any *taxable supply of a luxury car that you make.

reach.condition: if it supplies or imports luxury cars
